title: System-command diversity with C_RD_NA_1 read command
purpose: Improve parser-entry diversity with a non-command-system type beyond C_SC_NA_1, using a valid read command structure with no extra object bytes beyond the IOA.
expected_behavior: The target should parse a valid read command APDU for TypeID 102 with one information object address and no additional object payload.
constraints_preserved: APDU length 0x0d matches 4 APCI bytes plus 9 ASDU bytes
ASDU header ordering and widths are preserved
VSQ is one-object non-sequence and exactly one IOA is present
No unsupported extra object bytes are appended
issue_safety_notes: Adds system-command diversity with a complete minimal body and avoids unsupported field relations.
